page.layout: One page of text, verse centred below a running head; a catchword-like "AD" at the right below the verse; an ornament below; faint show-through of the facing page at the right edge, not transcribed.

main_text.p:
Sic spes Guisiadum vagas,
Optatamque tua morte Tyrannidem
Victor splendidus obteris,
Et tristi patriam funere liberas.
Heu! mens caca cupidine
Quum regni rapitur, quo ruit impetu
Praeceps per vetitum nefas?
Nullum turpe putat flagitium, aut scelus,
Leges iuraque negligit,
Caelesti arbitrio cuncta negans regi.
Nullos illa deos, neque
Plectendis metuit Tartara sontibus.
Fertur filia mortuum
Conculcasse ferox Tullia Servium
Bigis, dum properat patris
Regem cade sui cernere coniugem.
Regno fraudibus impiis
Davidem pepulit filius Absalom.
Quem mox dextera Numinis
Feriens aetherei perdidit exitu
Tristi, qui manet improbos
Conatus meritum supplicium ferens.

page.notes: Verse lines are set as one paragraph with line breaks; the line-final forms are copied as printed. The "AD" at the right is a catchword. The printed ornament at the foot is a tailpiece and is not transcribed. The text is slightly faded at the right margin, where show-through from the facing page appears.
